newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola Enterprises completes bottler buy.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola Enterprises completes bottler buy.

text.p: Coca-Cola Enterprises said Monday it completed the previously announced acquisition of Coca-Cola & Schweppes Beverages Ltd.

The company said it purchased Cadbury Schweppes' 51 percent interest and Coca-Cola Co's 49 percent interest in the British bottler for a total transaction value (purchase price plus acquired debt net of other long-term obligations) of about 1.2 billion pounds sterling, or about $2.0 billion based on current exchange rates.
Coca-Cola Enterprises said it received formal approval of the acquisition from the European Commission on January 22, 1997.
The company said the British Bottler produces products of Coca-Cola Co and Cadbury Schweppes for distribution in England, Scotland, and Wales.
